Crossref confirms the bibliographic record: Journal of Neuroscience Methods volume 250, pages 126-136, July 2015, Elsevier, licences listed are the Elsevier text-and-data-mining user licences only, which are not redistribution grants. source.md therefore contains the publisher abstract as deposited in PubMed (PMID 25596422), retrieved 2026-07-31 via NCBI E-utilities efetch, together with a header recording that provenance. md_quality is abstract-only for that reason: the abstract and metadata were the only retrievable content. The consequence is recorded explicitly on the card -- the paper's tabulated empirical chance levels as a function of sample size, class count, cross-validation scheme and classifier are reported but not accessible, and are worth re-attempting if an institutional copy becomes available, since those tables are the part this project would use.
